def count_white_hats(image_path):
    # Import Object Detector Tool
    from object_detector_tool import ObjectDetectorTool

    # Load image and object detection model
    detection = ObjectDetectorTool()
    detection.load_model("path/to/model")

    # Get image path of the desired object
    image_path = image_path

    # Detect objects in the image
    objects = detection.execute(image=image_path)

    # Filter objects to find white hats
    white_hat_objects = []
    for object in objects:
        if object["label"] == "baseball":
            # Assuming all baseball caps have the same background color
            if object["background"] != "white":
                white_hat_objects.append(object)

    # Count white hats
    white_hat_count = len(white_hat_objects)

    return white_hat_count
